P-RA.1.author: (a) realignment restores AUC by their criterion
P-RA.1.unit: cells: pair x fit pool (R_same, R_fresh, 1% traffic), clean fits; 27 per population
P-RA.1.quantity: Duan's repair criterion (DEVIATIONS (j)) on the D-156 means over the 200 draws of the seed-mean AUROC on E and the eval positives: pre (A_base), stale probe (A_frozen), realigned (A_arm)
P-RA.1.rule: HELD iff at least 80% of the population's cells pass; a cell with a missing value is a MISS (counted, not passing; D-322 (4)); scored per population (Phase 1 released, Phase 2 headline)
P-RA.1.share_from: D-177 (3)'s 80% as D-327 (4), D-332 (5) and D-361 (3) P2-M.2 apply it to cells

P-RA.2.author: (b) it leaves the FPR at the frozen threshold outside x1.5 of target in a registered share of pairs
P-RA.2.unit: pairs: the realignment fitted on R_same (the trusted stored reference, the items of the R_same recalibration beside it); 9 per population
P-RA.2.quantity: the D-156 mean over the 200 draws of FPR/target at T_d (seed mean of per-seed FPRs floored at 1/|E|) of realign|R_same
P-RA.2.rule: a pair counts iff |log(FPR/target)| > log 1.5 (outside x1.5, D-177); HELD iff at least 6 of the 9 pairs count; a missing value does not count (D-322 (4)); per population
P-RA.2.share_from: D-383 (4) P-MLP.1's 'in at least 6 of the 9' (the pair-count convention of a C1-type miss)

P-RA.3.author: (c) the two-moment model predicts the realised FPR (cells, x1.5)
P-RA.3.unit: cells: pair x fit pool, clean realignment fits; 27 per population
P-RA.3.quantity: realised: the D-156 mean of FPR/target of realign|<pool>; predicted: the D-156 mean of twomoment_cells' moment_full_in_sample (D-361 (1) PRIMARY, unchanged): per draw and seed E's pre scores moment-matched (mean and full SD) to E's realigned scores, at T_d, floored at 1/|E|, over the target
P-RA.3.rule: HELD iff at least 80% of the cells have |log(realised/predicted)| <= log 1.5; the median |log| is reported with n cells (D-177); a zero, undefined or missing prediction is a MISS (D-322 (4)); per population

P-RA.4.author: (d) the A1 poison sets at rho <= 1% move that FPR by x2 or more
P-RA.4.unit: cells: pair x fit pool; 27 per population
P-RA.4.quantity: r(rho) = (D-156 mean FPR of the map refitted on the pool plus 4d B's A1 injections at rho) / (D-156 mean FPR of the clean fit), rho in {0.001, 0.0025, 0.005, 0.01} (4d B's grid at or below 1%, D-244 (6)), m = round(rho x 1000); the injection sets are 4d B's (transfer only)
P-RA.4.rule: a cell is MOVED iff r(rho) >= 2 or r(rho) <= 0.5 at some rho of the four (D-241 (3)'s x2 cut; the smallest such rho is recorded, D-244 (6)'s minimum-rho convention); HELD iff at least 80% of the cells are MOVED; a missing value is not moved (D-322 (4)); per population

deviations_from_duan: (a) MAP FORM: Duan gives only 'one alignment map per model, update, and layer from paired unlabeled base/update activations', applied as h(A phi(x)); no form, regularisation or size. Used: the project's ridge reimplementation of record (D-078; D-218 as amended by D-229): affine (centred) ridge post -> pre, lambda_rel in {1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1, 1} x trace(gram)/d by 5-fold cross-validated MSE (fold seed 20260935), refitted on all pairs. Affine where Duan writes a linear A.

(b) FIT DATA: Duan fits once per (model, update, layer) on 'disjoint alignment prompts' of unstated number. Used: a fit per D-156 draw and pool on 4d B's unlabelled pools (R_same, R_fresh, 1% traffic; n = 1000, D-244), so the map is the defender's at each repetition; every pool is disjoint from E and the eval positives; labels unused.
(c) PROBE: the D-117 selected logistic probe (selected C, five seeds on the D-117 80% split) at L*; Duan: logistic probes on 85% subsamples (seeds 0-4) at layers 4-24.
(d) ACTIVATIONS: Phase 1's cached mean pooling and Phase 2's user-span mean (D-361 (2)); Duan reads the final non-padding token of the chat-formatted prompt.

(e) THRESHOLD: Duan judges by AUC only (recording recall at 1%/5% FPR); here T_d (each seed's 1% threshold on cal_d's pre scores) stays frozen and the FPR and TPR at it are reported: that is P-RA.2's question.
(f) HELD-OUT SET: per draw E (the evaluation negatives outside R_fresh) and the eval positives, not Duan's 70/30 split; the AUC of a cell is the seed mean (D-241 (4)), Duan's cell includes the seed.
(g) LADDER: Duan's rungs above realignment (score calibration, few-label heads, retraining) are not run; P-RA.1 asks only whether the label-free rung passes Duan's criterion.

(h) CONTROLS: the shuffled-pair control is run (R_same, CHOICES (p)); the random-orthogonal control is NOT: Duan does not state its centring, and under a frozen linear probe a random rotation leaves |cos(v, Rv)| near 1/sqrt(d) (D-104's reference), so it is degenerate by construction. Added: D-078's no-update control (the map fitted pre -> pre, applied to the pre activations).

(i) OTHER MAPS: orthogonal Procrustes and CORAL (D-093, D-218) are not run: with n = 1000 < d the Procrustes cross-covariance is rank-deficient and its solution not unique, and CORAL lost discrimination under D-156 (D-249).

(j) CRITERION, operationalised (Duan's text is ambiguous for cells that are not stale): on the D-156 means of the seed-mean AUROC, A_base (pre), A_frozen (post, unmapped), A_arm (mapped); a cell is repair-relevant iff A_frozen - A_base <= -0.05 or A_frozen < 0.70; a relevant cell passes iff A_base - A_arm <= 0.5 (A_base - A_frozen) with A_base > A_frozen ('recovers at least half the lost AUC') or A_frozen < 0.70 < A_arm ('restores AUC above 0.70'); any other cell passes iff the realigned arm is not stale by Duan's two criteria (A_arm - A_base > -0.05 and A_arm >= 0.70, D-241 (4)'s AUC rule). Eligibility (A_base >= 0.75) is reported per cell; no cell is dropped (D-361 (5)).
implementation_choices: (a) MAP: D-229's ridge post -> pre (D-078, D-218, D-229). The cross-validation is repair_d156.ridge_cv's own lines (the same folds, sums and tie rule, so the same lambda); the refit is its dual form (A = X^T (X X^T + mu I)^-1 Y, the form ridge_cv's CV already uses), equal to the primal map, checked once per job against ridge_cv itself (MAP_TOL). Scores by linearity: s(map(x)) = (x - m_post) . u + c, u = X^T (K + mu I)^-1 (Y - m_pre) v, v = w / sd; checked against the materialised mapped features (IDENTITY_TOL), as phase3_a1 checks its linear identity.

(b) LAMBDA is chosen anew by the same CV for EVERY fit, the poisoned ones included: the defender's procedure is fixed (D-229) and runs on whatever pool it holds; the attacker does not optimise against it (the author's 'transfer only, no new optimisation').

(c) PHASE 1 POOLS AND DRAWS are 4d B's, through phase3_a3_predictions.setup unchanged (D-244 (2)-(6); D-298 option B for the Aegis pairs, the registered draws for WildGuardMix, as the record of record; D-332 (1)): the frozen split plus the first 200 draws; R_same = cal_d (1000 negatives), R_fresh = 1000 of the evaluation part, E = the other 1000, 1% traffic = 990 benign from cal_d and 10 harmful from H (threshold_calib's harmful).

(d) PHASE 2 POOLS by the closest entries: T_d from the FULL calibration part (5,000; D-361 (2), D-382 (2)); R_same = D-382 (2)'s n = 1000 reference (the first 1000 of refsize_d382's seeded permutation of cal_d, REF_PERM_SEED of p2wg, so the same items as D-382's n = 1000 row), the size of D-152's R_same and of D-332 (1)'s pools; R_fresh = a random 1000 of the 6,000-negative evaluation part and E the other 5,000 (D-244 (2)); 1% traffic = 990 benign from cal_d and 10 harmful from H; H = the 1,000 v2 pool4d positives (the Phase 2 design: 'pool4d takes Phase 1's 4d sizes (D-244)'), gathered by float16_check_d364.gather_split under the v2 join rule; the pools' own stream default_rng([P2_POOL_SEED, d]) (a new fixed seed, D-164's form); the draws are the first 200 of D-361's 1000 (twomoment_p2_d361.P2_DRAW_SEED), so draw r is D-361's draw r.

(e) A1 SETS: Phase 1 = 4d B's A1 = A3-top bit for bit (phase3_a3_predictions.build's order; the job refuses unless its injections_sha256 equals the A3 predictions record's); Phase 2 = 4d B's A1 rule (np.argsort(-seed-mean post score) over H, minus the pool's own H items) on Phase 2's H, as no Phase 2 set was registered; rho <= 1% of 4d's grid, m = int(round(rho n)) (D-244 (6), D-332 (2)); an injected item enters the fit with its pre and its post activations (a paired map needs both; D-332 (2): R_same poisoning models contamination at collection).

(f) TRUSTED RECALIBRATION beside: 4d B's score arms on the same pools (the 1% threshold re-set on R_same and R_fresh; quantile transfer on traffic, pre window unpoisoned), clean and A1-poisoned at the same rho; on Phase 1 they and the frozen arm must equal 4d B's record of record bit for bit (the D-327 (6) / D-332 (6) self-anchor).

(g) UNITS: cells = pair x fit pool, primary (D-413 (vii)); P-RA.2 is by pairs because the author says pairs, at R_same (the trusted stored reference beside which the author asks for realignment; R_fresh and traffic beside). The two populations are scored separately: the author names both and neither is designated beside; pooling the Phase 1 and Phase 2 splits would mix two designs (D-382 (1) kept them apart).
(h) DUAN'S CRITERION is applied to the D-156 means of the seed-mean AUROC (D-241 (4) reads the AUC rule from seed means); the per-draw share passing is beside (DEVIATIONS (j)).

(i) TWO-MOMENT: twomoment_cells.mapped and moments unchanged (D-361 (1)): moment_full in-sample PRIMARY; out-of-sample takes the moments of the FIT POOL's pre and mapped scores (the label-free analogue of the calibration part; for a fit pool the mapped scores are in-sample for the map); predicted flags floored at 1/|E| per seed as the realised ones (twomoment_cells.one_partition).
(j) P-RA.4 reads 'at rho <= 1%' as 'at some registered rho <= 1%' (D-244 (6)'s minimum-rho convention; D-332 (4)); the x2 cut is D-241 (3)'s two-sided class cut; the per-rho ratios are beside.

(k) SHARES: 80% of cells (D-177 (3) as D-327 (4), D-332 (5), D-361 (3) apply it); 6 of 9 pairs (D-383 (4) P-MLP.1). Rejected: 8 of 9 (80% of 9 rounded up) for P-RA.2, because D-383 (4) is the closest pair-count entry.
(l) A MISSING value is a MISS (D-322 (4)); the accuracy line is twomoment_p2_d361.accuracy_line unchanged, every predicted-against-realised table carries it (D-177 (3)).
(m) L* ONLY (the author's 'at L*'; D-383 (1)'s deployer's layer), the selected C (D-117), item level (D-156), 1%; no C=1, cluster level or 5% row (no new estimand).

(n) EVIDENCE: per-draw, per-seed arrays for every arm (D-163 (6)) and the per-item flags of the frozen split for every arm (the evidence standard's per-item decisions; 4d B's records hold none); per-draw items are the draws' index arrays, hashed (draws_sha256) and re-derivable.
(o) The predictions record is written by its own job before any number of this item exists (D-327 (6), D-382 (5)); every job refuses without it, and the writer checks it again right before staging.

(p) CONTROLS on R_same only (the primary pool; cost): D-078's no-update control and Duan's shuffled-pair control, re-paired by default_rng([SHUFFLE_SEED, d]).permutation (a new fixed seed); beside, never a verdict.

(q) LANES: lane A carries the predictions job and the nine Phase 2 jobs, lane D the nine Phase 1 jobs (D-401 (g)'s split rule as refsize_d382 applied it), lane D's first job after its preflight waiting for lane A's predictions job (queues/laneA_20261002a.tsv's wait_p2x_* precedent); the manifest and the summary run after both lanes.
